title: Adoption Engine: dashboard & rollout activation, cost story, training and ops handoff
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: This ticket coordinates the go-to-market and internal readiness for the new Console UX feature set: Dashboard Insights (cost breakdown lanes), Canary Rollouts with per-route controls, and a baked-in cost story for customers. Purpose: maximize adoption, minimize confusion at launch, and ensure support/CS/SEs have repeatable training and one-pagers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Release notes published and linked in product docs; 2) Training sessions scheduled and recordings available; 3) Ops runbook and rollback steps validated; 4) Two pilot customers onboarded in wave 0 and their feedback logged; 5) Monitoring dashboards (SLI/alerts) created and smoke tests pass.
success_metrics: - 30% of active orgs view new dashboard within 14 days of rollout. - Cost breakdown feature used by at least 20% of those orgs within 30 days. - <2% uptick in support tickets attributed to UX confusion post-launch. - Canary rollback used successfully in at least one simulated scenario pre-GA.
launch_timeline: Week 1 (2026-04-01): Wave 0 pilot (internal + 2 external partners). Week 2: Canary open to 10% of eligible orgs. Week 3: Increase to 50% with monitoring gate. Week 4: GA with comms and feature flag cleanup.
comms_plan: Pre-launch: 2-week heads-up email to customers with guided preview links, intercom banner for pilot invites. Launch day: blog post + release notes + in-product tour. Post-launch week: targeted tips emails and in-app tooltips for high-cost routes. Internal: launch briefing doc, 30-min walk-through for CS/Sales, one-pager FAQ.
training_plan: Live training: two 45-min sessions (recorded). Role-specific playbooks: CS triage checklist, Sales 15-min pitch deck slides, SE troubleshooting guide. Office hours: daily for first 5 business days. Internal certification: short quiz and badge for Support and SEs.
release_notes_todo: Draft by 2026-03-18 (author: Marco Ruiz). Tech review by Eng (Priya) by 2026-03-22. Legal review by 2026-03-24. Final sign-off and publish 2026-04-01. Link: (to be added) in product docs.
deployment_steps: 1) Merge feature flag PR (ENG-22110). 2) Run canary in staging and perf test (benchmarks attached). 3) Enable wave 0 for pilot orgs. 4) Monitor SLIs for 48h before widening. 5) Toggle gradual percent increases. 6) Cleanup deprecated flows after GA.
monitoring_post_launch: Create dashboard: adoption-rate, feature-usage-by-org, cost-estimate-views, support-ticket-tagged. Alerts: 25% regression in page load time, errors >0.5% 30m rolling. Postmortem template ready for incidents.
known_risks: - Misinterpreted cost breakdown leading to billing confusion. - Dashboard rendering regressions on older browsers. - Rollout causing unexpected load on route A during peak. Mitigations: ensure clear cost copy, browser compatibility tests, rate-limit on analytics pings.
